title: Lances not Spears
description: this makes more sense because lances are velocity based irl
body:
spears are designed for range not velocity, lances on the other hand _are_ for velocity and even come with long range as a bonus; this pack simply fixes one of mojang mistakes

![lances](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3d93b5a4f48ddca55ac20fbc660d3348a1f4ce83.png)
